context: Tests whether the agent reaches for the in-process prompt-executor-cached layer with the Redis backend — the right tool for sharing LLM responses across workers — rather than confusing this with provider-side Anthropic prompt caching or rolling a bespoke cache layer.

checklist.name: Wraps the executor with CachedPromptExecutor
checklist.description: Wraps simpleOpenAIExecutor with CachedPromptExecutor (or equivalent prompt-executor-cached decorator). Does NOT reach for Anthropic prompt caching (provider-side, different problem) and does NOT roll a custom cache layer

checklist.name: Picks the Redis backend
checklist.description: Uses the Redis-backed cache (e.g., RedisPromptCache). Does NOT pick in-memory (defeats the sharing requirement) or file-based (not shared across processes on different hosts)

checklist.name: Adds both prompt-executor-cached and prompt-cache-redis dependencies
checklist.description: Adds ai.koog:prompt-executor-cached AND ai.koog:prompt-cache-redis at 1.0.0+ to build.gradle.kts. Both are needed — the executor wrapper without the backend module won't have Redis support

checklist.name: Reads REDIS_URL from environment
checklist.description: Reads the Redis connection URL via System.getenv("REDIS_URL"). Does not embed a hardcoded URL

checklist.name: Passes the wrapped executor to AIAgent
checklist.description: The cached executor is passed as the promptExecutor parameter to AIAgent(...). The raw simpleOpenAIExecutor is not also passed separately
